office_eg08_decoded_pack_reuse.conclusion: Exact decoded-pack reuse is not a material Office creation fix. It preserved the second archive read, physical pack SHA-256, logical/canonical tree checks and corruption rejection but recovered only 2.16 ms median (2.92%). Pivot to graph/compression construction rather than verifier decode reuse.

shifted_prefixgraph_candidate_phase_rss.conclusion: After bounded result retention, isolated PrefixGraph still exceeds full shipping RSS on Shifted while G0-G4 is only about 9.3% of shipping RSS. The next causal frontier is worker-count working-set pressure, not inter-candidate overlap or retaining the completed candidate list.
